name: Portfolio
description: One crypto portfolio: tracked addresses, price controls, snapshots and the reconciler's record of its own wiring.

global.schema:
type PortfolioState {
  name: String
  baseCurrency: String!
  addresses: [AddressEntry!]!
  priceOverrides: [PriceOverride!]!
  ignoredAssets: [String!]!
  autoSnapshot: AutoSnapshot!
  snapshots: [Snapshot!]!
  positions: [WalletPositions!]!
  resources: ManagedResources
  lastCheck: ReconcilerCheck
  grant: GrantInfo
  bundles: [Bundle!]!
  categoryRules: [CategoryRule!]!
  categoryOverrides: [CategoryOverride!]!
}

"""
A named group of the portfolio's wallets: every page can be filtered to it.
"""
type Bundle {
  id: OID!
  name: String!
  addresses: [String!]!
}

type AddressEntry {
  id: OID!
  address: String!
  chainId: Int!
  label: String
  ensName: String
  tags: [String!]!
  ignored: Boolean!
  addedAt: DateTime!
}

type PriceOverride {
  asset: String!
  price: String!
  setAt: DateTime!
}

type AutoSnapshot {
  enabled: Boolean!
  intervalHours: Int!
}

type Snapshot {
  id: OID!
  timestamp: DateTime!
  totalValue: String!
  netWorth: String
  liabilities: [SnapshotLiability!]
  perLocation: [LocationValue!]!
  perAsset: [AssetValue!]!
}

type SnapshotLiability {
  asset: String!
  amount: String!
}

type LocationValue {
  location: String!
  value: String!
}

type AssetValue {
  asset: String!
  amount: String!
  value: String!
}

type WalletPositions {
  wallet: String!
  chainId: Int!
  fetchedAt: DateTime!
  positions: [PositionEntry!]!
}

type PositionEntry {
  protocol: String!
  kind: PositionKind!
  assets: [PositionAsset!]!
  note: String
}

type PositionAsset {
  asset: String!
  amount: String!
}

enum PositionKind {
  SPOT
  LP
}

type ManagedResources {
  connectionId: String!
  workflowIds: [String!]!
}

type ReconcilerCheck {
  at: DateTime!
  issues: [ReconcilerIssue!]!
  fixes: [ReconcilerFix!]!
}

type ReconcilerIssue {
  code: String!
  severity: IssueSeverity!
  message: String!
  accountId: String
}

type ReconcilerFix {
  code: String!
  message: String!
  at: DateTime!
}

enum IssueSeverity {
  BLOCKING
  WARNING
}

type GrantInfo {
  id: String!
  name: String
  grantedAt: DateTime
}

"""
A counterparty rule: every matching transaction gets the category.
"""
type CategoryRule {
  id: OID!
  counterparty: String!
  chainId: Int
  direction: CategoryDirection!
  asset: String
  category: TxCategory!
  label: String
}

"""
One transaction's category, chosen by hand.
"""
type CategoryOverride {
  wallet: String!
  eventId: String!
  sequenceIndex: Int!
  category: TxCategory!
  giftCost: String
  giftAcquiredAt: DateTime
}

enum CategoryDirection {
  IN
  OUT
  ANY
}

enum TxCategory {
  TRADE
  SPEND
  INCOME
  STAKING
  LENDING_INCOME
  MINING
  AIRDROP
  AIRDROP_NON_TAXABLE
  GIFT_IN
  GIFT_OUT
  DONATION
  LOST
  STOLEN
  DEPOSIT
  WITHDRAWAL
  COLLATERAL_OUT
  COLLATERAL_IN
  BORROWING
  LOAN_REPAYMENT
  LIQUIDATION
  FEE
  MARGIN
}
